meta.name: Wall Reachability Test
meta.notes: Tests that walls meaningfully shape the reachability graph. The wall at [0,1] blocks the direct top-row access to [1,1]. Without this wall, picking [0,1] would immediately open [1,1]. With the wall, [1,1] is reachable only via [0,0]→[1,0]→[1,1] or [0,2]→[1,2]→[1,1]. [2,1] becomes reachable only after [1,1] is emptied. Uses initial empty cells at [2,0] and [2,2] to keep the grid small.
